deploy-bot: :rotating_light: starting staged rollout: model-service v2 (variant: beta) -> 50% traffic in prod at 2026-03-15T01:12:02Z
Priya: rolling this now, post-canary looked clean. scaling policy unchanged.
Alex: watching metrics — I already see a tail latency bump in eu-west-1 1min ago. can you post the dashboard link?
Priya: dashboard: https://redwood.ops/dash/model-service/latency?q=last_5m  — 95th moved from 210ms -> 1.2s for 60s window. errors (5xx) up ~3x.
incident-bot: Paging on-call: @Alex — elevated errors detected for model-service after staged rollout.
Alex: on it. taking pager. :hand:
Jen: customer support pinged — a handful of paying integrations seeing timeouts and retries. ticket 34291 references production /generate 504s.
Alex: thanks. Priya, what was the rollout knob exactly? was this a traffic-steer or a model-variant swap behind the same route?
Priya: it's a variant-switch via feature flag: flags.model_service.variant_beta = 0.5. LB still same route, runtime chooses kernel path for beta (quantized path).
Alex: could be quant kernel path jitter on certain GPUs. check kernel selection logs on nodes in eu-west-1.
Priya: pulling logs...
Priya: (log snippet)
```
[03-15T01:11:58Z] node-12 gpu0: selected kernel kv_cache_q8_optim
[03-15T01:11:59Z] node-12 gpu0: kernel init latency 480ms
[03-15T01:12:00Z] node-12 gpu0: enqueue request 120ms
[03-15T01:12:01Z] node-12 gpu0: warn: max_queue_time exceeded
```
Alex: that kernel init latency is the suspicious bit. looks like kernel JIT path cold-start on some pods.
Mateo: I'm seeing pod churn too — a subset of pods restarted at rollout time. liveness probe flapped on node-12.
Priya: hmm we had a sidecar change in the canary earlier, but it passed canary. maybe combination of variant path + sidecar ordering.
Alex: immediate mitigation: kill the feature flag to 0 (route all traffic back to stable v1). Priya, can you flip and confirm?
Priya: running flag toggle now: `rwctl flags set model_service.variant_beta 0`
Priya: done. wait 30s for traffic to drain. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Feature flag change detected by deploy-bot: model_service.variant_beta set to 0 by Priya at 2026-03-15T01:13:10Z.
Priya: traffic now at 0% to beta across regions.
Alex: monitoring... latency trending back down in eu-west-1. 95th is 230ms now. errors dropping.
Jen: sent update to support and affected customers: brief apology + rollback note. kept it factual.
Mateo: K8s events show the restarted pods were due to startup timeouts when connecting to the cache shim (sidecar init order). that combined with kernel cold-start gave spikes.
Alex: root cause hypothesis: sidecar init delay + kernel JIT cold-start for quantized variant caused request pileup and liveness probe failures.
Priya: agree. next steps: revert sidecar ordering change in next patch, add a warm-up path for kernel JIT (preload on startup), and tighten canary gating to include 95th-tail tests and pod-startup histograms.
Alex: going to open an incident and tag SRE runbook. Mateo, can you create the Jira and attach logs? include timeline, rollback time, customer impact. I'll start a postmortem draft.
Mateo: on it. Jira INC-2026-318 created. attaching logs + kube events + flag history.
Alex: handoff to next on-call (Jen) in 2 hours. Jen, can you own follow-ups and make sure the hotfix PR is queued?
Jen: will do. I'll also request a retro with runtime and infra teams tomorrow.
incident-bot: incident created INC-2026-318 by Alex. Severity: Sev2. Current status: mitigated (rollback to stable).
Priya: quick sanity check — should we also temporarily increase autoscaler max for eu-west-1 while warmers are added, to avoid liveness flapping under load?
Alex: no, I prefer to avoid scaling band-aids. we'll add warmup prefetch and faster kernel seeding instead. but if error rate climbs again we can revisit.
Jen: timeline summary for handoff:
- 01:12:02 root: staged rollout to 50% started
- 01:12:45 metrics: tail latency and 5xx spike detected
- 01:13:05 incident-bot paged on-call
- 01:13:10 flag set to 0 (rollback) by Priya
- 01:14:00 metrics improving, traffic back to stable
- 01:20:00 ticket and incident created, affected customers notified
Jen: I'll include that in the handoff note and paste links to dashboards + Jira.
Mateo: adding runbook step to pre-seed kernels on deploys and to add pod-startup histogram to canary gating.
Alex: thanks everyone. closing the active pager but keeping the incident open for postmortem until the fix lands. :thumbsup:
